responsibility: Provides the minimal error-reporting implementation used by GCC host generator programs rather than the full compiler diagnostic subsystem. It owns the simple progname/have_error state and implements plain stderr-based warning, error, fatal, internal_error, trim_filename, and fancy_abort routines, producing uncomplicated textual messages and process termination suitable for gen* build tools and other generator-side utilities.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the lightweight errors pair: it provides the actual stderr-based warning/error/fatal/internal_error, have_error/progname state, trim_filename, and fancy_abort logic for host generator programs, whereas errors.h only declares that minimal API.
